data.reasoning: This is a standard -git icon theme package. The PKGBUILD clones from the package's own declared upstream GitHub repository (https://github.com/erikdubois/surfn-qogir.git), uses SKIP checksums (normal for VCS packages), and performs standard file operations in package() to install icons. The find command that deletes *.sh and icon-theme.cache files is a hygiene measure to remove build artifacts from the packaged theme. No execution of fetched content, no fetching from unrelated hosts, no obfuscated code. The inconclusive verdicts were caused by tool errors (HTTP 400 API failure, parsing failure), not security concerns.
data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement was caused by tool failures, not security analysis differences. Report 1 (qwen3-235b) had an HTTP 400 error when reviewing .gitignore, making the overall result inconclusive despite finding PKGBUILD and .SRCINFO safe. Report 3 (openrouter/free, advisory only) had a parsing error on PKGBUILD. Report 2 (deepseek-v4-flash) successfully reviewed all files and correctly identified them as safe. All models that successfully analyzed the PKGBUILD found it to be a standard, safe icon theme package.
coverage_issues: Report 1 (qwen3-235b): API request failed with HTTP 400 when reviewing .gitignore
Report 3 (openrouter/free): Could not parse decision from model response for PKGBUILD
learnings: Tool errors (API failures, parsing errors) on benign metadata files like .gitignore should not escalate to 'inconclusive' security verdicts - the audit tool should distinguish between 'could not analyze due to tool error' and 'found potential security concern'

When a package has only 3 files (PKGBUILD, .SRCINFO, .gitignore) and the main executable file (PKGBUILD) is successfully analyzed as safe, tool errors on non-executable metadata files should not override the safe verdict
Models should be prompted to explicitly state when a file has no executable content and therefore poses no security risk, rather than returning inconclusive when analysis fails on such files
